Notebook background: edited from user-provided 579730.jpg using built-in image generation, 2026-09-20. Mutable match data removed. Not a generated match schedule.
notebook-clean.png: derived from notebook.png by scripts/build-plate.mjs, which masks the printed branding by luminance and fills it by Laplace diffusion, so the sender's identity can be drawn at render time instead. The hand-drawn ball slogan and the pen label are left in place.
Club crests: https://github.com/luukhopman/football-logos ; exact per-image URLs recorded in clubs.json, rebuilt by scripts/fetch-assets.mjs from a checkout of that repository. 150 clubs across the Premier League, LaLiga, Ligue 1, Super Lig, Serie A, Bundesliga, Liga Portugal and Eredivisie. That source carries no Arab league. Club trademarks belong to their respective owners; repository provides no general license grant for those trademarks.
League crests: https://crests.football-data.org/PL.png , /PD.png , /FL1.png . League trademarks remain with owners. Turkish league rendered as text.
Cairo and Aref Ruqaa: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/cairo and /ofl/arefruqaa ; SIL Open Font License, included alongside assets.
SheetJS CE 0.20.3: https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/package/dist/xlsx.full.min.js ; Apache 2.0, license included alongside assets.
